planets.name: HD 6061 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of HD 6061 with a 5.25-day year, found in 2023.

text.card: HD 6061 b was found in 2023 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around HD 6061. Its orbit and size follow MacDougall et al. 2023's fit, the archive's default.
